# sleuthkit / fls_ext_fuzzer

sleuthkit's own fuzz target `fls_ext_fuzzer` ([source](source/fls_fuzzer.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over sleuthkit (sleuthkit/sleuthkit at 424ee3ce).

mem_open wraps the input as a raw 512-byte-sector image; tsk_fs_open_img(FSTYPE) then tsk_fs_fls(FULL, root, RECURSE) with a NULL output path; results unused.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against sleuthkit at commit 424ee3ce.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch sleuthkit` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fls_ext_fuzzer.plain` | 1,383,832 | `6cea7276b5895b03abc353585481b3641428073fdb63acfb604836102dfdc2c0` |
| ubsan | `fls_ext_fuzzer.ubsan` | 1,521,464 | `fb6bf134a82072a5537efa1d8c7914eecffaae4e674945030b208ff53d6722d1` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
